text:
Lina Torres: heads-up: vendor call this morning flagged a late-stage regression in H100 FW candidate when running very long sequences (>4096 tokens). we need to decide marketplace phasing and comms.
Ethan Wu: ugh. is it correctness or perf?
Samir Patel: vendor says it's a slowdown in the attention kernel causing tail-latency spikes, not corruption. reproducer attached to ticket.
Grace Li: given that, i'm thinking we should: 1) push Gaudi as GA in EU/US markets this month, 2) mark H100 as 'delayed GA / pilot only' and 3) expose H200 as the recommended fallback SKU in the marketplace tile.
Lina Torres: agree with the direction. also need to consider SI partners who rely on H100 memory layout optimizations. they asked for a migration note and a short patch for our SDK.
Ethan Wu: do we have capacity constraints if we promote H200 heavily? some regions only have limited H200 inventory.
Samir Patel: inventory lookup shows H200 capacity sufficient for initial wave in us-west/us-east but eu-west is light. we can advertise regional fallback: prefer h200 in us, gaudi in eu, b200 as cost option globally.
CommsBot: Reminder: embargo window for joint announce tentatively 2024-05-05. :bell:
Grace Li: proposal for marketplace rollout windows:
- Wave 1 (04/26): Gaudi-stable (registry.redwood.ai/gaudi:stable-20240426), B200 economy tile
- Wave 2 (05/05): H200 recommended fallback + H100 pilot (if vendor FW hotfix lands by 04/30)
- MI300: keep "preview" status until driver 1.3.0 addresses hangs under heavy JIT workloads
Ethan Wu: we should also publish clear rollback criteria in the partner brief: e.g., 99.9th latency > 3x baseline OR P99 error spike > 0.5% over 30m -> immediate tag rollback and routing to fallback.
Samir Patel: agreed. add a metric for KV cache regressions too (miss rate > 10%).
Grace Li: sample routing policy snippet for partners (short):
- primary: model=h100 tag=pilot-2024-05-05
- fallback: model=h200 tag=latest
- degrade: model=b200 tier=economy
- region-fallback: eu-west->gaudi:stable
Lina Torres: thanks. Ethan, can you prepare a quick canary plan for H200 and Gaudi with these tests: latency_p99, kv_warmup, quantization_consistency, sdk_memory_smoke.
Ethan Wu: will do. canary manifest example i'll push to the runbook.
SI Onboard Bot: SI partners requested: 72h notice before promote + sample client diff for memory layout.
Samir Patel: we should give SIs a short SDK patch and migration guide. Grace, can you own that brief?
Grace Li: yes, i'll draft a 2-page migration note and include a small diff patch for rdw-sdk. estimated EOD today.
CommsBot: FYI: press ops prefer a single narrative. if H100 slips we'll need to shift to a "hybrid availability" announcement and call out H200/Gaudi availability first.
Lina Torres: action items recap:
- Ethan: canary plan + run (staging + canary cluster) by 04/24
- Grace: partner brief + SDK patch by EOD 04/22
- Samir: region capacity map + recommended SKUs per region by EOD 04/22
- Lina: schedule partner pre-brief once canaries are green
Ethan Wu: kicking off canaries on staging now. will post results.
SI Onboard Bot: Canary job 9921 queued for gaudi-stable; job 9922 queued for h200-fallback.
Ethan Wu: gaudi canary started: latency_p99 baseline check in progress.
Samir Patel: small risk note: some SI integrators will need overnight builds for quantized ops; might delay their internal dry-run by 24-48h. we should flag that in the partner brief.
Grace Li: added to draft. also adding a short FAQ for SIs about quantized kernels and expected perf differences.
Ethan Wu: gaudi canary results: 4/4 tests passed. h200 canary: 3/4 passed, quantization_consistency failed on a specific model (reported to vendor).
Lina Torres: thanks. given that, we'll proceed with Wave 1 (Gaudi + B200). hold Wave 2 signoff until h200 quantization fix and vendor FW for H100 are approved.
CommsBot: vendor meeting scheduled: 04/30 10:00 for FW final candidate review. :calendar:
Lina Torres: i'll set a quick 04/29 internal signoff call (partner ops + legal + comms). if everything green, we go 05/05 for H200/H100 pilot.
Grace Li: posting partner brief draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/partnerships/marketplace-rollout-brief-0422. comments welcome.
Samir Patel: adding routing policy examples to the runbook now.
Ethan Wu: will re-run h200 canary after vendor patch and update logs here.
Lina Torres: great work team. closing thread; reopening if vendor ETA changes.
